text.content:
Virtues: Conscience and Self-Control

Not truly a Path of Enlightenment in the mystical sense, Humanity is the moral code that most mortals - and the vampires who cling hardest to their former lives - still follow. It emphasizes restraint, remorse, and loyalty to one's own kind and community above the demands of the Beast.

Hierarchy of Sin (most to least severe):

  1. Committing diablerie, or dealing with the infernal
  2. Betraying your sect, clan, etc. to the enemy, or bringing about the unlawful destruction of a Kindred in the same sect or clan
  3. Killing a mortal
  4. Torturing someone, or Embracing a mortal out of spite
  5. Wanton destruction, or not resisting frenzy
  6. Going against one's Nature

Followers of Humanity are found in every clan and sect, and largely make up the rank and file of the @UUID[Compendium.vtmlarp.sects.JournalEntry.fc464242d84d4e34]{Camarilla} and independent Kindred who have not fallen fully to the Beast.
